main_text.l: Io Sarei amáto Quũ ego amarer.
colúi Sarébbe amáto, si Amerébbe, Amerébbesi ille amaretur.
coloro Sarébbono amati, si Amerébbono, Amerébbonsi, & Amerébbonsi illi amarentur.
colúi Saría amáto, si Ameria, Ameriasi ille amaretur.
coloro Sariano amáti, si Ameriano, Amerianosi, & Ameriansi illi amarentur.
Io Saréi,& Saría státo amáto Quum ego amatus essem, vel fuissem.

page.notes: Ligatures and long-s forms in the Latin are reproduced as closely as possible. The "Quũ" and "Quum" words have a macron or tilde over the u. Some forms in the Latin column (Amerébbonsi, Ameriansi) are doubtful. The signature "g.iiii." is printed at the foot right.
